page.notes: The top title line is italic and continues from the previous page, so it is set as a level-2 head fragment. Printed marks "⌣" at the line ends of the title (after "fide", "dilectione" and "castitate") are line-end ligature or elision signs, not text, and are left out. The large initial Q of "qualis" is ordinary type. No marginal notes are printed. Long s is normalised to s throughout, including "Genef." and "Pfal.".
